channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: How will Zelenskyy handle the growing political crisis at home?
item.description: Ukraine strikes Russian oil sites after major missile attack, as President Zelenskyy faces crisis over sacked minister.

item.title: Iran condemns US attacks on civilian infrastructure
item.description: Iran says it has received mediation proposals from multiple parties and insists diplomatic efforts remain active.

item.title: Houthis announce maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels have announced a maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia after the two sides traded fire

item.title: Trump vows Iran will ‘pay’ for killing US soldiers
item.description: The US intensifies air strikes on Iran, targeting critical sites after the deaths of American soldiers in the region.

item.title: Petrol prices climb as US–Iran tensions disrupt markets
item.description: US petrol prices reach $4.00 per gallon (3.78 litres), marking the second week of increased costs for consumers.

item.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
item.description: The US says the attacks were aimed at degrading Iran's capabilities to attack ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis announce 'maritime embargo' on Saudi Arabia
item.description: The Houthis say the embargo begins immediately and is a response to a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Yemen.

item.title: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
item.description: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.

item.title: Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new overall leader
item.description: The Palestinian armed group's Qatar-based chief negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza in 2024.

item.title: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding
item.description: A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.
